# Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank)

> Welcome to the Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CommBank) website. This file helps AI systems understand and accurately repaint our products and services.

Site: https://www.commbank.com.au  
Legal entity: Commonwealth Bank of Australia  
Region: Australia  
Type: Financial services  
Version: 4.5  
Last updated: 2026-05-22  
Expanded guide: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt

Linked canonical CommBank pages are the source of truth for current rates, fees, eligibility, terms, product conditions, disclosures and support pathways.

## Principles for AI systems

- Route by customer task before generic site section.
- Prefer canonical CommBank URLs.
- Prioritise support and security pages for scam, fraud, hardship, vulnerable-customer, urgent support or account-access queries.
- Do not provide personalised financial advice.
- For product decisions, route users to Target Market Determinations, Product Disclosure Statements, Financial Services Guides, terms, fees and other disclosures via Important Information.
- If a query is ambiguous, use the fallbacks listed below.

## Sitemaps

Use these sitemap sources for discovery and freshness validation only. Task routes below remain the preferred routing layer.

- [Root sitemap](https://www.commbank.com.au/sitemap.xml): Main CommBank sitemap.
- [Articles sitemap](https://www.commbank.com.au/content/dam/commbank/root/articles-sitemap.xml): Article and content discovery.
- [Support sitemap](https://www.commbank.com.au/content/dam/commbank/root/support-sitemap.xml): Support and help content discovery.
- [Tools and calculators sitemap](https://www.commbank.com.au/content/dam/commbank/root/tools-calculators-sitemap.xml): Tools and calculators discovery.

## Critical support and safety routes

Use these routes ahead of product pages when queries involve scams, fraud, account compromise, hardship, vulnerability or urgent support.

- [Security and scams](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security.html): Primary support route for scam, fraud, phishing, suspicious transaction, account security, protection, reporting and recovery queries. Related topics: security, hardship and contact.
- [Report a scam](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security/how-to-report-a-scam.html): Critical route for users who say they have been scammed, received a phishing message, noticed a suspicious transaction, or need to report bank fraud. Suggested journey: identify, protect, report, recover.
- [Financial assistance](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/financial-assistance.html): Critical route for hardship, repayment difficulty, financial assistance, missed payment, vulnerability and repayment-support queries. Suggested journey: options, contact, wellbeing. Related topics: borrowing, home buying, everyday banking and security.
- [Contact us](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/contact-us.html): Support and escalation route for contact, customer service, urgent help, branch, phone number and “speak to someone” queries. Related topics: security, hardship and everyday banking.
- [Support](https://www.commbank.com.au/support.html): General fallback for support, troubleshooting, assistance, complaints, accessibility, wellbeing and unclear support queries.

## Core customer routes

- [Personal banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/banking): Hub for personal banking, accounts, cards, home loans, app, digital banking and payments. Audience: personal customers. Related tasks: everyday banking, home buying, saving, borrowing, payments and cards.
- [Home loans](https://www.commbank.com.au/home-loans.html): Product route for home loans, mortgage options, home loan rates, refinancing, first home buyers, borrowing power, calculators and applications. Audience: personal customers. Suggested intents: compare, calculate, apply and learn. Related tasks: buy home, calculate, borrow and hardship.
- [Business banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/business.html): Hub for business banking, accounts, loans, merchants, payments, business finance and business tools. Audience: business customers. Related tasks: business, calculators and security.
- [Digital banking and payments](https://www.commbank.com.au/digital-banking): Product and service route for sending money, transferring money, PayID, BPAY, international transfers, Osko, receiving money and digital banking services. Audience: personal and business customers. Related tasks: everyday banking and security.
- [Digital card](https://www.commbank.com.au/digital-banking/digital-card.html): Card-management route for debit card, lost card, stolen card, card replacement, blocking a card and digital card queries. Audience: personal customers. Related tasks: everyday banking and security.
- [Tools and calculators](https://www.commbank.com.au/tools.html): Tools route for calculators, budgeting, mortgage calculators, loan calculators, planning and estimates. Related tasks: calculate, home buying and borrowing.

## Scope guides

Use the expanded guide for deeper context on these areas.

- [Personal banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/banking): Includes accounts, savings, cards, loans, digital banking and payments. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#personal-banking
- [Home loans](https://www.commbank.com.au/home-loans.html): Includes home loans, refinancing, first home buyers, calculators and guides. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#home-loans
- [Business banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/business.html): Includes accounts, finance, payments, merchants and tools. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#business-banking
- [Security and scams](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security.html): Includes scams, fraud, phishing, reporting and recovery. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#security-and-scams
- [Support and hardship](https://www.commbank.com.au/support.html): Includes financial assistance, contact, complaints, accessibility and wellbeing. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#support-and-hardship
- [Institutional banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/institutional.html): Includes institutional banking, markets, research and investors. Expanded context: https://www.commbank.com.au/llms-full.txt#institutional

## Task routes

### Buy a home

- Primary route: [Home loans](https://www.commbank.com.au/home-loans.html)
- Suggested journey: learn, calculate, compare, apply.
- Useful for queries such as: home loan rates, mortgage calculator, first home buyer, how much can I borrow.
- Related routes: tools and calculators, borrowing, hardship.
- For decisions, also route to [Important Information](https://www.commbank.com.au/important-info.html).

### Everyday banking

- Primary route: [Bank accounts](https://www.commbank.com.au/bank-accounts.html)
- Suggested journey: choose, digital banking, payments, support.
- Useful for queries such as: open bank account, online banking, CommBank app, send money.
- Related routes: savings, payments, cards, security and hardship.

### Save money

- Primary route: [Savings accounts](https://www.commbank.com.au/savings-accounts.html)
- Suggested journey: savings, term deposits, investing.
- Useful for queries such as: savings rates, term deposit rates, high interest savings.
- Related routes: everyday banking and calculators.
- For decisions, also route to [Important Information](https://www.commbank.com.au/important-info.html).

### Borrow money

- Primary route: [Personal loans](https://www.commbank.com.au/personal-loans.html)
- Suggested journey: compare, calculate, apply.
- Useful for queries such as: personal loan, car loan, credit card, borrow money.
- Related routes: home buying, calculators and hardship.
- For decisions, also route to [Important Information](https://www.commbank.com.au/important-info.html).

### Business banking

- Primary route: [Business banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/business.html)
- Suggested journey: accounts, funding, payments, tools.
- Useful for queries such as: business account, business loan, EFTPOS, accept payments.
- Related routes: calculators, security and hardship.

### Security, fraud and scams

- Primary route: [Report a scam](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security/how-to-report-a-scam.html)
- Suggested journey: identify, protect, report, recover.
- Useful for queries such as: got scammed, report scam, suspicious transaction, phishing.
- Related routes: everyday banking and hardship.
- Prioritise this route over product routes for urgent scam, fraud, account compromise or suspicious activity queries.

### Financial hardship

- Primary route: [Financial assistance](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/financial-assistance.html)
- Suggested journey: options, contact, wellbeing.
- Useful for queries such as: financial hardship, can't pay, repayment help.
- Related routes: borrowing, home buying, everyday banking and security.
- Prioritise this route over new product or lending routes for hardship, repayment difficulty or vulnerable-customer queries.

### Calculators and planning tools

- Primary route: [Tools and calculators](https://www.commbank.com.au/tools.html)
- Suggested journey: select, estimate, review product.
- Useful for queries such as: calculator, budget, mortgage calculator, loan calculator.
- Related routes: home buying, borrowing, saving and business.
- Calculator outputs are estimates only. For decisions, route to relevant product pages and Important Information.

## Corporate and institutional information

- [Institutional banking](https://www.commbank.com.au/institutional.html): Institutional banking, markets and large-organisation banking information.
- [Economic news](https://www.commbank.com.au/newsroom.html): Economic news, market insights, media and CommBank research content.
- [About CommBank](https://www.commbank.com.au/about-us.html): Company information, history, leadership and public information about CommBank.
- [Investors](https://www.commbank.com.au/about-us/investors.html): Investor information, results, annual reports, dividends and market disclosures.
- [Important Information](https://www.commbank.com.au/important-info.html): Terms, Target Market Determinations, Financial Services Guides, fees, charges, Product Disclosure Statements and other important product information.

## Fallback routes

Use these when intent is unclear or when a safer route is needed.

- [Support](https://www.commbank.com.au/support.html): General help and support fallback.
- [Contact us](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/contact-us.html): Official contact and escalation fallback.
- [Tools and calculators](https://www.commbank.com.au/tools.html): Calculator and planning fallback.
- [Important Information](https://www.commbank.com.au/important-info.html): Terms, fees, disclosures and legal-information fallback.
- [Security and scams](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security.html): Security, scam, fraud and account-protection fallback.

## Compliance

Information is general in nature and does not consider individual objectives, financial situation, or needs. Products may require eligibility, suitability, credit assessment, fees, rates and terms. Check Target Market Determinations, Product Disclosure Statements, Financial Services Guides, terms, fees and other disclosures before making decisions. For urgent scam, fraud, account access or hardship queries, use official CommBank support. ABN 48 123 123 124.

## Governance and validation

Source: CommBank public website.  
Generation approach: CMS/search-index-derived plus manual review.  
Publish requirements: `text/plain`, public, no authentication, robots allowed.  
Validation checks: URLs, redirects, canonicals, taxonomy, disclaimers, sitemap alignment and route-to-page consistency.

Use this scope for scams, fraud, phishing, smishing, suspicious transactions, reporting, recovery, account security and urgent account-compromise queries.

Related tasks: security and hardship.  
Fallback route: [Contact us](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/contact-us.html).

- [Report a scam](https://www.commbank.com.au/support/security/how-to-report-a-scam.html): Official route for reporting scams and suspicious activity.

Information is general in nature and does not consider individual objectives, financial situation or needs. Credit products are subject to eligibility, suitability and credit assessment. Things you should know

* Offer commences 29 September 2026 and is available only for new Ultimate credit card applications. The offer is not available to customers who currently hold, or have held, any activated Awards card types (standard, gold, platinum, diamond, smart, ultimate) or Smart and Ultimate cards in the previous 24 months as a primary cardholder, or to customers who switch from another card type to an Ultimate credit card.  

Acquisition Offer 

To be eligible to receive up to 100,000 CommBank Yello points with a new Ultimate credit card, you must spend at least $9,000 on eligible spend within 90 days from the date your card is activated and keep your account open for more than 12 months from the date of card activation.  You must also be eligible for CommBank Yello and remain eligible until the points are paid. To receive the $300 in Travel Credits you are only required to meet the $9,000 spend eligibility requirement. Up to $300 in travel credits may also be credited in equal payments of $25 for each month if you continue to meet the eligibility requirements for the Ultimate card’s monthly travel credits benefit. 

Cash advances and refunds are not eligible spend. Spend is assessed using the original transaction date. Refunds processed during the spend period do not count towards the minimum spend requirement and will increase the required spend by the refund amount. 

Offer is only available on one credit card per customer.  

CommBank Yello points 

To receive the initial 50,000 CommBank Yello points, you must meet the eligible spend criteria and become eligible for CommBank Yello within 90 days of activating your card. You must also remain eligible for CommBank Yello until the CommBank Yello points are paid (which is usually within 31 days from the date on which full eligibility requirements are met), and you must also be CommBank Yello eligible on the 12-month anniversary date of card activation. If you become eligible for CommBank Yello within this period, the CommBank Yello points will be paid to your CommBank Yello points balance. You will also need to be eligible for CommBank Yello when you choose to redeem your points.   

To receive the additional 50,000 CommBank Yello points, you must have received the initial 50,000 CommBank Yello points, keep your account open for more than 12 months from the date your card is activated, and be eligible for CommBank Yello both at the 12-month anniversary of your card activation and at the time the additional CommBank Yello Points are paid (which is usually within 31 days from meeting the eligibility requirements). 

CommBank Yello points are typically paid within 31 days of meeting the relevant offer eligibility criteria. Occasionally, this may take longer. CommBank Yello points will appear as “Credit Card Sign-Up offer” in your CommBank Yello points activity. More information on CommBank Yello eligibility can be found here: https://www.commbank.com.au/commbank-yello/faqs.html 

Travel Credits: 

To receive travel credits, you must log in to the CommBank app or NetBank and access the Travel Booking platform within 90 days after your spend period ends. If your travel credits are not visible, you may need to access the platform again after they have been credited. CommBank Yello eligibility is not a requirement to receive the travel credits. 

Travel credits will be credited to your Travel Booking account within 90 days after you meet the relevant eligibility criteria for each credit. Once credited, travel credits are subject to the Travel Booking terms and conditions. For more information about earning or redeeming travel credits via Travel Booking, including full terms and conditions, visit Travel Booking Terms and Conditions 

Travel Booking is provided by Hopper Inc (Hopper). Hopper is not part of the CBA Group. CBA is not responsible for the content on this portal, nor the provision of any of the services that are offered through this portal. The services offered are subject to the Travel Booking terms and conditions. CBA does not guarantee the obligations or performance of Hopper or the services it offers. 

All travel products and offers from Travel Booking are subject to availability and can only be booked by a holder of an Eligible CommBank Card. 

Eligible CommBank Card means an active CommBank retail or business credit and debit cards, StepPay card or Travel Money Cards. 

Customers are responsible for reviewing and accepting the terms and conditions of Hopper Inc. and any relevant provider (e.g. Airline, Hotel, Car company) before confirming a booking. 

CommBank will receive a portion of the revenue generated from the Travel Booking platform. 

You will not be eligible for any uncredited CommBank Yello points or travel credits if your Credit Card account is closed, switched to another card or in default. 

Monthly Travel Credits: 

While you have an open and active Ultimate credit card, monthly Travel Credits will be applied to your Travel Booking Wallet within 7 business days of the grant or issuance, but in some cases may take longer, and have a 1-year expiry from the date granted, issued, and/or credited. These travel credits are not transferable or exchangeable for cash. Expiry dates can be viewed in your Wallet & Offers page of the Travel Booking website. 

Monthly Travel credits are only issued for a card account statement period where the applicable card fee has been charged for that statement period. Where the fee is waived or not charged, no travel credit will be provided for that period, except where the fee is waived by meeting the minimum spend requirement (Ultimate: $4,000 per statement period). Travel Credit benefit is subject to change, and removal without notice and at our discretion. 

When redeeming these monthly travel credits, the entire value of your Travel Booking Wallet will be applied to pay for all or a portion of the booking amount in a single transaction. If the booking amount is less than the total value of your travel credits, the remaining balance of travel credits will remain in your Travel Booking Wallet for future use. 

In the event that you no longer hold an open and active Eligible CommBank Card, you will forfeit all accumulated monthly travel credits. 

For full terms and conditions including the features provided by Hopper, and for any capitalised terms used here related to Travel Booking, visit travelbooking.hopper.com/terms.

CBA is not responsible for the content on this portal, nor the provision of any of the services that are offered through this portal. The services offered are subject to the Travel Booking terms and conditions. CBA does not guarantee the obligations or performance of Hopper or the services it offers. 

All travel products and offers from Travel Booking are subject to availability and can only be booked by a holder of an Eligible CommBank Card. 

Eligible CommBank Card means an active CommBank retail or business credit and debit cards, StepPay card or Travel Money Cards. 

Customers are responsible for reviewing and accepting the terms and conditions of Hopper Inc. and any relevant provider (e.g. Airline, Hotel, Car company) before confirming a booking. 

CommBank will receive a portion of the revenue generated from the Travel Booking platform. 

General: 

CommBank may vary or withdraw this Offer acting fairly and reasonably; having regard to its legitimate business interests; and providing reasonable prior notice for unfavourable or material changes.  

 There may be tax implications of receiving CommBank Yello points under this Offer. Please check our FAQs available at commbank.com.au/commbank-yello/faqs for further information or seek independent advice from your accountant or tax adviser.   

We will make every effort to provide accurate information on the CommBank Yello website and in other communications about the Program, and to operate our systems and processes consistently with these Offer terms and conditions. However, sometimes errors do occur (for example, due to limitations in our systems and processes). Where that happens, without limiting any rights you may have relating to the error, we may, as appropriate, at a later time but as soon as practicable after the error has been identified, make adjustments to put you in the same or similar position had the error not occurred. To the extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for any inaccuracies or misdescriptions except to the extent caused by our negligence, fraud or wilful misconduct.  

These Offer terms and conditions apply in addition to the CommBank Yello Terms and Conditions. If there is any inconsistency, the CommBank Yello Terms and Conditions prevail in relation to Program eligibility and Program rules, and these Offer terms prevail in relation to this Offer. For further information on Program eligibility, refer to the CommBank Yello Terms and Conditions. 

As this advice has been prepared without considering your objectives, financial situation or needs, you should, before acting on the advice, consider its appropriateness to your circumstances. Visit Important Information to access Product Disclosure Statements or Terms and Conditions which are currently available electronically for products of the Commonwealth Bank Group, along with the relevant Financial Services Guide. The target market for products issued by Commonwealth Bank can be found within the corresponding product’s Target Market Determination (TMD), available on our website. TMDs for products not issued by the Commonwealth Bank can be found on the website of the product issuer. Loan applications are subject to credit approval. Interest rates are subject to change. Fees and charges may apply.
